name: Minnesota FFA
what_you_do: Join an agriculture class and your school's FFA chapter. You build leadership and career skills. Members can go to leadership conferences, a winter leadership summit and the State FFA Convention.
who_can_apply: You must be enrolled in an agriculture, food and natural resources (AFNR) course at a school with an agricultural education program. The page lists no age or grade rule. If your school has no program, the site links to how to start one.
pay_detail: National FFA dues are $7 a year. Minnesota State FFA dues are $11 starting in 2026. That is $18 for both. Local chapters and regions may charge more.
duration: School year, tied to your ag class
deadline_text: No application deadline. You join through your school's agriculture program.
how_to_apply: Talk to your school counselor or agriculture teacher and sign up for an agriculture course. Joining FFA goes through that class.
notes: The home page reports 218 agricultural education programs in Minnesota. Ask your counselor whether your school has one.
